disposition_reason: Table 2 prints lead, cadmium and tin for each of 33 beekeeper honeys from three regions of Sistan and Baluchistan, and the Results give overall and regional means and ranges.

study.design: Survey of beekeeper honey by region
study.origin: Sistan and Baluchistan Province, Iran: North (Zahedan, Zabol; urban/industrial, dust storms), Center (Khash, Iranshahr, Saravan; semi-industrial and agricultural), South (Sarbaz, Nikshahr, Chabahar; coastal/rural)
study.method: Dry ashing at 550 °C, 2 M HCl dissolution; GF-AAS (PerkinElmer AAnalyst 700)
lod: LOD (ppb): Pb 0.8, Cd 0.2, Sn 2.5; LOQ (ppb): Pb 2.6, Cd 0.7, Sn 8.3 (Table 1); the text also gives the Cd LOD as 0.2 µg/L
study.qa: Recoveries 94-106%; repeatability RSD <= 4.1%; no CRM reported

unresolved: Seven of 16 printed Cd values are below the stated Cd LOD of 0.2 ppb and all are below the LOQ of 0.7 ppb.
Sampling dates not reported; the ethics code is from Iranian year 1399 but no collection period is stated.
Whether the LOD in ppb refers to sample mass or to the measured solution (text also says 0.2 µg/L) is unclear.
